description: The peer-to-peer wire protocol (docs/WIRE_PROTOCOL.md): every message as a whole frame, malformed frames with the error a decoder must give, and the prefixes on which a stream decoder must already fail. Made by reference/tools/make_vectors_wire.py. `blocks` and `txs` hold the wire form (CONSENSUS_V2.md 15) of each block and transaction as hex; a compact block's `header` and `coinbase` are their wire forms as hex.
